_comment: WC2026 ROUND OF 16 (bracket tie 94: winner of Mexico-Ecuador vs winner of England-DR Congo). KNOCKOUT: no draw -- level after 90' -> extra time -> penalties, so the deliverable is who ADVANCES. Winner meets Norway (who upset Brazil) in the quarter-finals. Routes: Mexico is the HOST -- won Group A with a PERFECT nine and ZERO conceded (2-0 South Africa, 1-0 South Korea, 3-0 Czech; GF 6 GA 0, rating 79), an ELITE defence (three clean sheets), and beat Ecuador 2-0 in the R32 (another clean sheet). Mexico plays with a real home advantage (Mexico City / North American support). England won Group L (4-2 Croatia, 0-0 Ghana, 2-0 Panama; 7 pts, GF 6 GA 2, rating 91) and beat DR Congo 2-1 in the R32 (Kane brace, came from behind); Kane is firing. Class gap ~12 (91 vs 79) -> England the favourite by class. KEY tension: Mexico's ELITE defence (0 conceded across the group + a clean sheet vs Ecuador) and REAL home advantage narrow that gap sharply -- this is NOT a comfortable England tie. Both defences are strong; Mexico's ATTACK is modest (wins 1-0/2-0). -> a TIGHT, LOW-scoring tie (1-1/0-1/0-0 shape) with elevated extra-time/penalty risk, England favoured but Mexico very live at home. BTTS RULE (v2) APPLIED: England the clear-ish favourite AND Mexico has a MODEST attack (not an elite striker like Norway's Haaland) -> lean BTTS toward No; trimmed Mexico's attack lightly (1.08 -> 1.02) -> BTTS ~50/50 (slight No), England clean sheet 36%. Note the DOUBLE clean-sheet possibility: Mexico's elite D can shut England out (Mexico CS 23.5%) AND Mexico's modest attack can be shut out (England CS 36%) -> both-shut-out is a real branch, hence low total (2.47) and Under lean. Home = Mexico (REAL home). Cards not modelled (referee TBD).

notes: Strong (rating 91), Kane firing (brace vs DR Congo). attack 1.15 -- but faces the best defence in the draw (Mexico, 0 conceded) -> chances suppressed.
Solid defence (GA 2) but conceded to DR Congo. defense 0.90 -> Mexico can nick one at home.
Favourite by class; a tight, low-scoring tie against an elite defence + home crowd -> favoured but no comfort.
